notes.title: v1.0.3 - Spaceship Unlock Change! + NEW GAME!
notes.content:
Enjoyers of Ogre Chambers DX I got news for you!!

Game's now better than ever!
[list]
[*] Spaceships are unlocked with [b]combined score[/b] of all spaceships! 😎
[*] Easier [b]Star Target[/b] scores 😱
[*] [b]Smoother gameplay[/b] 🧴
[*] Almost 25% [b]smaller file size![/b] Ear destroying main menu music is gone 🤯
[/list]

[h1][b]MORE GOOD NEWS![/b][/h1]
I have released a new game on Steam!!

Lake of Creatures is a d[b]ifficult action FISHING ROGUELIKE, where you slaughter mutated creatures with weapons that shoot lasers and explosions!!![/b] 💥
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808320/Lake_of_Creatures/

Please check out my new game! 💖 It has some similarities and maybe even a reference to Ogre Chambers 😉

notes.title: Easier Spaceship Unlocks!! - v1.0.2
notes.content:
I've noticed the requirements for unlocking new spaceships have been too high so I decided to make unlocking them a little easier!

Update features:
[list]
[*] Lower spaceship unlock requirements on all spaceships.
[*] Adjusted star target requirements.
[*] Spaceship doesn't get stuck to the ceiling anymore when hugging the ceiling while shooting downwards.
[/list]

[h3]Side note:[/h3]
Also! If you've been enjoying [b]Ogre Chambers DX[/b], you will surely like my next game, a fishing roguelike releasing soon on 25th of May! Please check it out :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808320/Lake_of_Creatures/

notes.title: Polish Localization & Fixes! - v1.0.1
notes.content:
Small update featuring:

[list]
[*]Polish localization
[*]Players who have reached star target score now have their star shown in global leaderboards.
[*]Hotkeys to enable/disable fullscreen. (F4 & F11)
[*]Fixes in German localization
[*]Fixed crash when pressing ESC when viewing leaderboards in game over screen.
[/list]

Thanks for checking the game out <3
Please consider dropping a [b]review[/b] :)
